article.relatedIntro: Keep working without leaving your browser.

learn.title: JSON guides
learn.metaTitle: JSON guides — errors, formats, and fixes | JSON Bits
learn.description: Practical guides to JSON errors, number precision, CSV conversion, and choosing between JSON and YAML. Everything runs in your browser. No account needed.
learn.intro: Short, practical explanations of the JSON problems that take the longest to diagnose. Every guide links to a browser tool that does the work locally.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: What JSON Bits stores, what it never sees, and why the tools work without sending your data anywhere. Everything stays inside your browser.
notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: That URL does not match a tool or a guide. Try one of these instead.
tool.json-formatter.description: Format and indent JSON with precise syntax errors and big-number safety.
tool.json-validator.description: Validate JSON syntax and locate the exact line and column of errors.
tool.json-minifier.description: Remove whitespace from JSON without altering values or number precision.
tool.json-viewer.description: Explore large JSON as a fast, keyboard-friendly tree.
tool.json-diff.description: Compare two JSON documents and see added, removed, and changed values.
tool.json-repair.description: Fix trailing commas, comments, smart quotes, and other common JSON mistakes.
tool.json-to-csv.description: Convert JSON arrays into clean CSV with nested-key flattening.
tool.csv-to-json.description: Turn CSV rows into JSON arrays or objects with type inference.
tool.json-to-yaml.description: Convert JSON to readable YAML with configurable indentation.
tool.yaml-to-json.description: Convert YAML documents to JSON safely in your browser.
tool.json-to-xml.description: Convert JSON to XML with configurable root names and attributes.
tool.xml-to-json.description: Convert XML to JSON while preserving structure and attributes.
tool.json-sorter.description: Sort object keys alphabetically at every depth.
tool.json-escape-unescape.description: Escape or unescape JSON strings for code, logs, and APIs.
tool.jsonpath-tester.description: Test JSONPath expressions against your data and inspect matches.
tool.json-to-typescript.description: Generate TypeScript interfaces from a JSON sample.
tool.json-schema-validator.description: Validate JSON against a JSON Schema and read clear errors.
